selected_evidence.requirement: Create the platform group and secure collaborative workspace
selected_evidence.summary: Direct output shows `platform:x:1001`, `/srv/platform` owned by `root:platform`, mode `2770`, group/default ACL permissions, successful cross-user collaboration, outsider permission denial, and the clean final state.

The healthy baseline recorded boot ID `4eaf428d-1724-4431-a764-c9e0fdc350cc`; node1 acknowledged the delayed native reboot; it returned with boot ID `ea9ccbb0-7731-4f13-90c9-a41c31747a86`; checksum, group, workspace ACLs, collaboration, outsider denial, and system health all recovered.

commands.command: printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; uname -a; getent group platform || true; if [ -e /srv/platform ]; then stat -c 'path=%n type=%F owner=%U group=%G mode=%a (%A)' /srv/platform; else printf '%s\n' 'workspace=absent'; fi; command -v setfacl || true; command -v getfacl || true
